summary: Comprehensive testing of P2 Features: CSV Export and Email Configuration. All 11 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend UI components verified working. CSV export with proper headers, JSON backwards compatibility, admin-only email config endpoints, and format toggle all functional.
passed_tests: GET /api/export/tasks?format=csv returns valid CSV with headers (task_id,title,status,priority,due_date,created_at)
GET /api/export/reminders?format=csv returns valid CSV with headers (reminder_id,title,remind_at,status,created_at)
GET /api/export/conversations?format=csv returns flattened message rows with headers (conversation_id,conversation_title,role,content,created_at)
GET /api/export/all?format=csv returns combined data with type column (type,id,title,status,priority,created_at)
GET /api/export/tasks?format=json still returns JSON (backwards compatible)
GET /api/export/tasks without format param defaults to JSON
GET /api/email/config returns configured status and sender_email (admin only)
POST /api/email/config saves sender_email (admin only)
Non-admin user gets 403 on GET /api/email/config
Non-admin user gets 403 on POST /api/email/config
CSV export contains actual data rows matching JSON count
Profile page shows Email Service Configuration section for admin users
Email config section has Resend API Key input, Sender Email input, and Save & Test button
Profile page shows 'Not Configured' badge when no Resend key is set
Email config section correctly hidden for non-admin users
Profile page shows JSON/CSV format toggle in Export section
Clicking CSV toggle changes export description text to 'Download your data as CSV files'
Clicking JSON toggle changes export description text back to 'Download your data as JSON files'
Export buttons download files in CSV format when CSV is selected (letsm-tasks-2026-04-22.csv)
Export buttons download files in JSON format when JSON is selected (letsm-tasks-2026-04-22.json)
Toast notification shows 'Tasks exported as CSV' on successful export
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 Features fully tested (Iteration 10). CSV export endpoints working with proper headers and Content-Disposition. Email config endpoints admin-only with 403 for regular users. Frontend Profile page shows email config section only for admin users with 'Not Configured' badge. Export format toggle switches between JSON/CSV and updates description text dynamically. Downloads work correctly with proper filenames.

csv_export.details: All 4 export endpoints support ?format=csv with proper CSV headers, Content-Type text/csv, and Content-Disposition attachment

json_backwards_compatibility.details: Default format is JSON, ?format=json works, existing behavior preserved

email_config_admin_only.details: GET and POST /api/email/config return 403 for non-admin users, work correctly for admin users

email_config_ui.details: Email Service Configuration section visible only for admin users with Resend API Key input, Sender Email input, Save & Test button, and configured/not configured badge

export_format_toggle.details: JSON/CSV toggle in Export section, description text updates dynamically, downloads use correct format

mocked_apis.resend_email: Resend email sending is MOCKED - no real API key configured. Config endpoint works but test email won't actually send.
